SELECT id, content_id, title, content_type_id, area_code, si_gun_gu_code, first_image1, first_image2, map_level, latitude, longitude, tel, addr1, addr2, homepage, overview FROM attractions
AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND content_type_id IN
#{contentTypeId}
ORDER BY title ASC, id ASC

SELECT /*+ NO_MERGE(b) JOIN_ORDER(b, a2) */ a2.id, a2.content_id, a2.title, a2.content_type_id, a2.area_code, a2.si_gun_gu_code, a2.first_image1, a2.first_image2, a2.map_level, a2.latitude, a2.longitude, a2.tel, a2.addr1, a2.addr2, a2.homepage, a2.overview, b.cal_score FROM ( SELECT a.id, COALESCE(SUM(af.score * sfw.weight), 0) AS cal_score FROM attractions a FORCE INDEX (attractions_content_type_id_area_code) LEFT JOIN attraction_features af ON af.attraction_id = a.id LEFT JOIN survey_feature_weight sfw ON sfw.attraction_features_id = af.feature_id
AND sfw.survey_id IN
#{surveyId}
AND 1 = 0
a.content_type_id = #{contentTypeId}
AND a.area_code = ( SELECT s.sido_code FROM sidos s WHERE s.sido_name = #{area} LIMIT 1 )
GROUP BY a.id ) b JOIN attractions a2 FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) ON a2.id = b.id ORDER BY b.cal_score DESC
